messages:
deploy-bot: Kicking off staged rollout: `inference-api` -> v2.4.2-rc1 at 7% (us-west-2). Notes: tokenizer micro-optimizations + KV cache soft-evict. Auto-rollback: p95 > 375ms or 5xx > 0.9% sustained 4m. Release notes: https://go/release/2026-05/v2.4.2
lucy: rolling. running canary evals and smoke suite now. excluding embeddings-heavy tenants. quiet window 22:30 UTC.
hamid: started synthetic traffic (canary-profile B). watching latency and model output diffs.
rachel: 3m in: p50 stable, p95 ~245ms, 5xx 0.1%. small spike in tokenization latency in zone b (~320ms tail).
lucy: ok flagging. HOLD additional ramp until infra sanity-checks zone b. votes: GO / HOLD?
hamid: HOLD for now. want 5 more minutes.
infra: looking at zone b logs. seeing increased RPC retries between tokenizer and cache service causing tails; appears to be transient network flaps not related to binary.
release-bot: Suggestion: isolate by rebalancing canary away from affected AZs. Command: `deploy-bot rebalance --service inference-api --region us-west-2 --avoid-az us-west-2b --percent 7`
lucy: +1 to rebalance. keep overall percent same but avoid the AZ.
deploy-bot: Rebalancing canary: shifting traffic away from us-west-2b over 90s. Will report when complete.
deploy-bot: Rebalance complete. us-west-2 canary now spread across a/c only. Observability: https://dashboards/release/1732129999
rachel: post-rebalance p95 dropped to ~260ms, 5xx stable. looks better.
hamid: recommend hold at 7% for 15m to validate. no signs warranting rollback.
lucy: agreed. we'll hold and collect evals. if p95 rises above 360ms or 5xx above 0.8% we'll discuss rollback.
infra: follow-up: network team fixed minor routing flap in us-west-2b; they'll run traceroutes and report.
release-bot: Note appended to release notes: "AZ-specific network flap caused brief tokenizer RPC retries; canary rebalanced away from us-west-2b and is on hold at 7% pending 15m watch."
lucy: thanks team. reconvene in 15m or sooner on alerts. :coffee:
